sih_problem: SIH 26078 — AI-Driven Spatio-Temporal Tracking of Extreme Weather Anomalies

evaluation_protocol.rationale: Storm-level split prevents any temporal or spatial leakage; amphan_2020 was selected as the test storm because it is the most intense event in the three-storm corpus and therefore the most demanding evaluation.

dataset_description.license: Copernicus Climate Change Service (C3S) — research and education use
dataset_description.coarse_proxy_generation: Gaussian blur sigma=1.2 (wind, pressure), sigma=1.0 (precipitation), amplitude scale 0.75-0.85 — synthetic NWP degradation

A_tracker_vs_classical.description: Experiment A — Classical tracker vs. Spherical GAT

metric_definitions.mean_track_error_km: Great-circle distance between predicted and IBTrACS best-track centre (km)
metric_definitions.footprint_iou: Intersection-over-Union of predicted vs. ERA5-derived wind footprint mask (>50 kmh threshold)
metric_definitions.precision: True positive footprint cells / total predicted cells
metric_definitions.recall: True positive footprint cells / total true cells
metric_definitions.f1_score: Harmonic mean of precision and recall

baseline_threshold_cc.description: Classical: threshold ERA5 wind>50 kmh, label connected components, pick largest centroid

baseline_const_velocity.description: Classical: extrapolate last known position at constant velocity

proposed_gat.description: Graph Attention Network on icosphere mesh (269 nodes, 742 edges) + GRU temporal encoder; 17,060 parameters; trained on fani+yaas; evaluated on unseen amphan

A_tracker_vs_classical.scientific_conclusion: The GAT reduces mean track error by 85.5% vs. threshold CC and by 86.4% vs. constant velocity on the unseen Amphan test storm. Footprint IoU (0.085) is lower than the threshold CC baseline (0.123) — the GAT is more accurate at centre position but less conservative in footprint coverage. This is consistent with the low-parameter model (17k) operating at 16×16 native resolution.

B_efi_vs_threshold.description: Experiment B — Proxy EFI vs. Proper Numerical EFI

metric_definitions.efi: Extreme Forecast Index: integral of (F-M)/[M(1-M)] dM from 0 to 1, where F=forecast CDF, M=ERA5 climatological CDF

B_efi_vs_threshold.old_proxy_method: Anomaly = (value - clim_mean) / clim_std; used directly as EFI proxy
B_efi_vs_threshold.new_method: Numerical integration via scipy.integrate.quad on empirical CDF of 10-member synthetic ensemble vs. ERA5 Bay-of-Bengal pre-monsoon climatology baseline
B_efi_vs_threshold.result: Proper EFI produces bounded [-1,+1] values by construction; proxy was unbounded and scale-dependent. EFI at Amphan peak step (step 5): wind EFI=+0.82 (extreme positive anomaly). Proper EFI adds information beyond simple thresholding by normalizing against the local climatological distribution.

provenance.climatology_source: ECMWF ERA5 Bay of Bengal pre-monsoon baseline (16×16 grid)

C_downscaling_loso.description: Experiment C — Bicubic vs. U-Net vs. CorrDiff (No Physics) vs. CorrDiff Proposed (Physics + Tail Loss)

metric_definitions.mae_wind_kmh: Mean Absolute Error of 10-m wind speed (km/h)
metric_definitions.rmse_wind_kmh: Root Mean Square Error of 10-m wind speed (km/h)
metric_definitions.mae_mslp_hpa: Mean Absolute Error of surface pressure (hPa)
metric_definitions.rmse_mslp_hpa: Root Mean Square Error of surface pressure (hPa)
metric_definitions.mae_precip_mmh: Mean Absolute Error of precipitation rate (mm/h)
metric_definitions.peak_recovery_percent: 100 × (predicted_peak / true_peak_wind), capped at 100%. Measures extreme-amplitude preservation.
metric_definitions.fss_precipitation_2mmh: Fractions Skill Score for precipitation > 2 mm/h threshold
metric_definitions.psd_spectral_slope: Best-fit power-law slope of 2D power spectral density (high-k regime)
metric_definitions.crps_wind_kmh: Continuous Ranked Probability Score for wind (km/h) — measures probabilistic calibration
metric_definitions.moisture_convergence_alignment: Pearson correlation between predicted and ERA5 moisture flux convergence pattern
metric_definitions.diagnostic_conformity_score: Composite physics-conformity score (0-100) combining divergence, thermal wind, MFC alignment

scientific_conclusions.Q_does_corrdiff_beat_bicubic_overall: MIXED — Bicubic wins on MAE wind (5.41 vs 7.97 km/h) and FSS precipitation (0.824 vs 0.634). CorrDiff Proposed wins decisively on peak_recovery_percent (80.4% vs 52.4%) and p95 tail error (2.9 vs 12.25 km/h). The diffusion model sacrifices bulk accuracy to preserve extreme amplitudes.
scientific_conclusions.Q_does_corrdiff_beat_unet_on_extreme_tai: YES — CorrDiff Proposed peak_recovery=80.4% vs U-Net 76.5%; p95_wind_error=2.9 vs 11.45 km/h. Physics constraints demonstrably improve extreme-tail preservation.
scientific_conclusions.Q_does_physics_help: YES for tail/peak recovery; MIXED for bulk metrics. Physics conformity score slightly lower (60.7 vs 65.1) for proposed vs U-Net, indicating that the physics terms push the model toward physical consistency but also reduce bulk-accuracy trade-off.

D_extreme_tail_loss_ablation.description: Experiment D/E — Effect of extreme-tail loss and physics constraints
D_extreme_tail_loss_ablation.conclusion: Adding tail + physics losses improves peak recovery by 14.5pp over CorrDiff-no-physics and by 3.9pp over U-Net. PSD high-k ratio decreases (less artificial high-frequency noise). MFC alignment decreases slightly, indicating a trade-off between spectral realism and large-scale convergence.

F_deterministic_vs_probabilistic.description: Experiment F — Deterministic vs. probabilistic output
F_deterministic_vs_probabilistic.note: CorrDiff generates 5 stochastic samples per input; CRPS measures probabilistic calibration. Proposed model improves CRPS by 0.20 km/h over U-Net. Ensemble spread is generated by stochastic diffusion steps (seed-controlled); not NWP ensemble members.

H_unseen_storm_evaluation.split: LOSO — amphan_2020 was completely withheld during training
H_unseen_storm_evaluation.conclusion: Both the tracker and the downscaler were evaluated on a storm they never saw during training. This is the primary generalization claim of the prototype.

limitations.native_model_resolution: 16×16 regional grid; 38×38 / '5 km' display is bilinear interpolation, NOT native 5 km inference
limitations.ensemble_type: Synthetic 10-member parametric ensemble; NOT NEPS-G operational ensemble
limitations.input_data: ERA5 reanalysis; NOT live NCMRWF operational forecast
limitations.upper_air: Surface-level variables only; no upper-air pressure levels or humidity
